category: managed AI agent platform with hosted computers

free_tier.stated: Start free with 5,000 credits to try the whole team; no card to start. Standard then costs $20 a month with 100,000 credits a month; a separate Standard 7-day trial requires a card.
free_tier.notes: The hosted computer is charged 252 credits per vCPU-hour and 81 credits per GiB-hour, so 5,000 credits pays for about 15 hours of the 1 vCPU / 1 GiB session computer at 333 credits an hour, within its 12-hour cap. Credits roll over and do not expire.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is an agent's computer, not an object; a file read or write is 4 MiB per call, publish_file or fetch_file moves up to 5 GiB per file, and shell output is 262,144 characters per stream

retention.stated: Included credit rolls over and never expires; a computer is auto-destroyed at 12 hours from create, and when its balance cannot pay the next 10-minute block it is paused with its disk kept.

egress.terms: The hosted computer runs on the platform; no outbound data volume allowance or per-TB price is published. Agent email is 4 credits per send however many recipients, web_fetch about 4 credits per page and web_search about 8 credits, and each phone-minute includes the residential network the traffic exits through.

interface_detail: Agents are driven from the studio chat and a REST API such as POST /v1/agents and /v1/computers, with a naive command line tool; computer files and shell are reached through the API's file and shell routes.
tooling: the studio, the REST API and the naive CLI; an agent's computer runs commands and files through the API and a browser, phone and mobile device can be attached to it
chaining: One company plan covers all agents with no per-person fee, and the same credit balance pays model inference, the hosted computer, web tools, media and phone minutes; files must be published off the computer with publish_file before its 12-hour auto-destroy.

limits.value: 12 hours maximum computer runtime from create to destroy; no per-computer override
5,000 credits to start, at 333 credits per hour for the 1 vCPU / 1 GiB session computer
4 MiB per file read or write call; 5 GiB per publish_file or fetch_file; 262,144 characters per shell output stream

limits_note: A computer you create yourself is billed ahead in 10-minute blocks and needs a balance covering one block to create or resume; a session's computer is metered per running second. There is no count limit on computers, only the balance.
binding_note: The 12-hour fixed lifetime with no override ends a long-running job whatever the balance, before the free credit or the per-call file cap is spent.

identity_cost.detail: Registration is by email and starts with 5,000 credits and no card; a Google or other social option is not shown on the signup page. A card is required only for the 7-day Standard trial, and one trial is allowed per organization and per person.

reliability_note: A computer is paused when its balance cannot cover the next 10-minute block and is auto-destroyed at 12 hours; an unfunded mobile device is ended with termination_reason unfunded, and a data or social data run past two minutes is stopped.
confidence_note: The free grant, credit rate, card-free signup and paid prices are quoted from the vendor's pricing and registration pages read on 2026-11-24; the runtime ceiling, metering and per-object caps are quoted from its own documentation.

shape.note: the session computer is 1 vCPU and 1 GiB; custom sizes are not published on the pricing page

extras.term: no expiry on credits; 12-hour hard ceiling per computer
extras.price_arithmetic: 5,000 credits at 5,000 per USD is USD 1; 333 credits an hour gives about 15 hours of the session computer, capped at 12 hours

network_out.note: web_fetch and web_search are priced per call; no host egress volume price is published
